name: direnv

patches.old:
download_url=$(
    curl "${curl_args[@]}" \
    | grep browser_download_url \
    | cut -d '"' -f 4 \
    | grep -E "direnv.$kernel.$machine(\.exe)?\$"
  )

resources.checksum_source: locally-pinned after HTTPS download; not an independently verified upstream checksum

smoke: mkdir -p /tmp/direnv-project; printf 'export OFFLINE_DIRENV_TEST=works\n' > /tmp/direnv-project/.envrc; "${OFFLINE_PREFIX}/bin/direnv" allow /tmp/direnv-project; "${OFFLINE_PREFIX}/bin/direnv" exec /tmp/direnv-project sh -c 'test "$OFFLINE_DIRENV_TEST" = works'
notes: Pins release and replaces API discovery and binary download. Shell hook remains the user's explicit setup step.
Functional test exposed Text file busy during overwrite after direnv exec. Download now stages a sibling file and atomically renames it, supporting reinstall while old processes exit.
